name: L3 Feature Confirmation.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
There are too many complex layer 3 features in an application.
We are now building a standard and simplified communication style.
Ready models
Please first refer to the datasheet, web manual and CLI manual
If not a result is found in those 3 files, then this function is not supported in the ready models.
Remark: Industrial and commercial models share the same web manual and CLI manual
Possible Issue
There are some results similar or close to the requirement, but not very sure if it is fully compliant.
Please come to us for confirmation.
If you have purchased a L3 switch from us, please look at the GUI for software version.
The latest version contains FULL L3 features in ready models(7.1.0 is the latest version now).
If the required functions are not found, then it is not supported.
If it is there, please do the testing.
Customized functions
If some features are not FULLY supported in our ready L3 switches(similar or close to your requirements after confirmation), please talk with us about customization.
Please know that this usually involves a decent quantity and some customization cost.
Unavailable features
Below features are not on our to-do list in the short term.
NAT
Stack
SD-WAN
TSN
MPLS
Cloud Management
In any case, you are welcome to talk with us for re-confirmation.
